messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The job scheduler has a deploy window on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-08-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-08]
    earlier: The job scheduler can be released on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-21 to 2025-08-08; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-21]
- The product catalog has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC as of 2025-11-12. [constraint; valid 2025-11-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-12]
    earlier: The product catalog has a deploy window on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-05-02 to 2025-11-12; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2]
- The reporting service has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-05]
- The webhooks service has a deploy window on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- The authentication gateway has a deploy window on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-14]
- Team Dune owns the job scheduler as of 2025-04-04. [valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-scheduler]
    earlier: Ember owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-04-04; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- The job scheduler remains a Team Dune service as of 2026-01-12. [valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-01-12]
- After the runtime upgrade, the job scheduler's cold start time tripled. [valid 2025-04-24 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-24]
- The scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009. [decision; valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The event bus deploys only on weekdays after 15:00 UTC per the change policy. [constraint; valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-17-2]
    earlier: The event bus deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC per the change policy. [constraint; valid 2025-04-22 to 2026-03-17; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-22]
- The scheduler is not a Boreal service; Boreal flagged the scheduler at standup on 2026-02-04. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-04]
- The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16 during INC-2026-009. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run. [valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-06-16]
- Billing-api has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 during the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- Boreal reported at standup on 2026-02-04 that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-04]
- The reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-08-20. [valid 2025-08-20 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-20]
- As of 2026-05-01, Ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [decision; valid 2026-05-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-01]
- The job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node. [decision; valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-06-16]
- The webhook dispatcher moved from Team Atlas to Team Dune on 2026-04-22. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-webhooks]
- The job scheduler depends on the flags service for per-job kill switches; if the flags service is down, the job scheduler is down. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-28]

Question: What was the deploy window for the scheduler before it changed?

message.reasoning:
The question asks about the deploy window for the scheduler (job scheduler) before it changed.

Looking at memory:
- The job scheduler has a deploy window on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-08-08 to now]
  - earlier: The job scheduler can be released on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-21 to 2025-08-08]

So the earlier window was Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.
